verdict.rationale: IAM lets you attach JSON policies to roles, and permissions boundaries can cap what an identity may do, giving fine-grained least-privilege scoping. Assuming a role issues temporary session credentials with no long-term keys, and OIDC federation lets external workloads such as GitHub Actions get scoped access. AgentCore separately claims to handle agent authentication and access control. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of issuing agent-scoped credentials, and detailed docs on agent-specific identity in AgentCore beyond marketing-level claims.
